package cue

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"cuelang.org/go/cue/cuecontext"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestValidate_Success(t *testing.T) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile("fixtures/valid.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	cctx := cuecontext.New()

	err = validate(b, cctx)

	require.NoError(t, err)
}

func TestValidate_Failure(t *testing.T) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile("fixtures/invalid.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, err)

	cctx := cuecontext.New()

	err = validate(b, cctx)
	require.EqualError(t, err, "flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout: invalid value 110 (out of bound <=100)")
}

func TestFeaturesValidator_MultipleErrors(t *testing.T) {
	validator, err := NewFeaturesValidator()
	require.NoError(t, err)

	b := []byte("flags:\n  - ey: foo\n    nabled: true\n    escription: hi\n    name: hey\n    variants: []\n    rules:\n      - segment: abc\n        rank: 1\n        distributions:\n          - variant: abc\n            rollout: 110\nsegments: []\n")
	result, err := validator.Validate("input.yaml", b)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrValidationFailed)
	require.Len(t, result.Errors, 4)

	for i, want := range []struct {
		path   string
		line   int
		column int
	}{
		{"flags.0.ey", 2, 5},
		{"flags.0.nabled", 3, 5},
		{"flags.0.escription", 4, 5},
		{"flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout", 12, 22},
	} {
		require.Equal(t, want.path, result.Errors[i].Path)
		require.Equal(t, Location{File: "input.yaml", Line: want.line, Column: want.column}, result.Errors[i].Location)
		require.Contains(t, result.Errors[i].Message, want.path)
	}
	require.Contains(t, result.Errors[3].Message, "<=100")
}

func TestFeaturesValidator_ValidResult(t *testing.T) {
	validator, err := NewFeaturesValidator()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	b, err := os.ReadFile("fixtures/valid.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	result, err := validator.Validate("valid.yaml", b)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Empty(t, result.Errors)
}

func TestValidateFiles_JSONWriter(t *testing.T) {
	var output bytes.Buffer
	err := ValidateFiles(&output, []string{"fixtures/invalid.yaml"}, "json")
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrValidationFailed)
	var result Result
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(output.Bytes(), &result))
	require.Len(t, result.Errors, 1)
	require.Equal(t, "flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout", result.Errors[0].Path)
}
